create_encoded_files_dataset: create a PyTorch dataset that reads random audio segments from encoded files using ffmpeg
create_h5_dataset: create a PyTorch dataset that loads audio data from HDF5 files with optional augmentation
dump_audio_to_h5: convert audio files in a directory to HDF5 format with optional normalization using sox
apply_pitch_augmentation: apply random pitch shifting augmentation to a segment of a WAV audio signal
create_dataset_set: create train and validation dataset loaders with optional data augmentation for music translation
